Thousands report problems accessing services
 Fernando Cervantes Jr. USA TODAY Updated Nov. 17, 2026, 1:15 p.m. ET Hear this story In the latest major outage in the United States, thousands of users are reporting problems accessing Apple services on Nov. 17, with Apple’s Support, App Store, iCloud and Apple Pay seeing problems.
 According to outage tracker Downdetector, reports of issues with Apple Pay began to spike at around 11:40 a.m. ET. Outage reports for iCloud also started so surge just before noon ET, though reports on Downdetector don't reflect every user experiencing a problem.
 The ongoing Apple outage comes on the heels of a major banking outage on Nov. 16 that stemmed from Chase Bank but impacted Wells Fargo, Bank of America, online payment platform Zelle and other institutions.
 Last week, a communications outage also disrupted air traffic across the United States, and a Microsoft outage prevented many from checking their Outlook email and accessing Microsoft 365 services like Teams and Word.
 USA TODAY contacted Apple on Nov. 17, but has not received a response.
